sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Compiler settings
sections.what: Sets strict checking, bundler-style module handling, React support, the at sign shortcut for the src folder, and includes all TypeScript files except node_modules.
sections.why: Likely reason: strict checks catch errors early and the shortcut keeps imports short.
sections.watch_out: Strict mode makes the typecheck fail on any loose type, and scripts and tests are included, so their errors count too.

summary: TypeScript compiler settings: strict type checking, the src shortcut, and which files are checked.
purpose: Catch type mistakes before the app runs.
why: Likely reason: strict checks catch errors early. The path shortcut keeps imports short.
how: 1) The editor and typecheck command read the file. 2) The include list says which files to check. 3) The path shortcut maps the at sign to the src folder. 4) No output files are written, because the build tool produces the app.
outputs: Type errors from the typecheck command. No output files.
risks: The include list covers scripts and tests too, so they affect typecheck results. The target is an old language version, so newer features depend on the build tool.
debug: If an at sign import fails, check the path shortcut and the alias in the test config. If typecheck fails only on a generated file, run the typegen step first.
